privacy.title: Your privacy matters
privacy.subtitle: PriceWise is designed as a privacy-friendly grocery comparison app. It does not use user accounts and avoids storing unnecessary personal information.

noAccounts.title: No user accounts
noAccounts.description: PriceWise does not require registration, login, usernames, or passwords.

localStorage.title: Shopping list stays local
localStorage.description: Your shopping list is stored in your browser using localStorage, not in a user account.

emailConsent.title: Email only with consent
emailConsent.description: Your email is used only when you choose to send your shopping list and confirm consent.

minimalData.title: Minimal data approach
minimalData.description: The application is designed to avoid collecting unnecessary personal data.

dataWeCollect.title: 1. Data we collect
dataWeCollect.text: PriceWise does not collect personal data through user accounts because the application does not include registration or login functionality.
dataWeCollect.email: If you choose to email your shopping list to yourself, the email address you provide is used only for sending that message.

localStorage.title: 2. Local shopping list storage
localStorage.text: The shopping list is stored in your browser using localStorage. This means the list remains on your device and is not connected to a user profile.

email.title: 3. Email consent
email.text: Before sending a shopping list by email, PriceWise asks for consent. The email feature is optional and only runs when you choose to use it.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and tracking
cookies.text: PriceWise does not require tracking cookies for core functionality. Any future analytics or optional tracking tools should be clearly explained and require appropriate consent where necessary.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-party services
thirdParty.text: PriceWise may use supermarket product pages as data sources and may use email delivery tools such as Nodemailer for sending shopping lists. These tools are used only for the app's intended functionality.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.text: Because PriceWise does not use user accounts, there is no account profile to delete. You can clear your shopping list at any time by removing it inside the app or clearing your browser storage.

side.title: Your privacy is important
side.text: PriceWise only uses the information needed for the app to work properly.
side.note: If new features are added in the future, this privacy policy will be updated so you can clearly understand how your data is used.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: We're on a mission to help smart shoppers save money by making price comparison simple, transparent, and accessible.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Empower shoppers with instant access to price comparisons across multiple stores, enabling informed purchasing decisions and maximum savings.

approach.text: We gather regularly updated pricing data from Greek supermarkets and present it in an easy-to-understand format.

privacy.title: Privacy First
